technical.title: Sensor Fusion via Point-Cloud Projection Enhances Autonomous Vehicle Perception
technical.summary: Advanced sensor fusion algorithms combine the high-resolution visuals of cameras, the all-weather reliability of radar, and the precise distance measurements of LiDAR to overcome individual sensor limitations in autonomous driving.
technical.why: Robust perception across adverse weather conditions is critical for deploying reliable autonomous driving systems.

technical.title: CLOCs-R Integrates Radar Evidence for Long-Range 3D Object Detection
technical.summary: CLOCs-R extends candidate-level sensor fusion by accumulating ego-motion compensated radar returns and appending Doppler and range features to camera-LiDAR pairs to improve long-range 3D detection.
technical.why: It directly addresses the limitation of sparse LiDAR returns and weak camera evidence at long distances in AVs.

technical.title: Real-Time GPU Solver Brings Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability Onboard Robot Control Loops
technical.summary: A new CUDA implementation of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs solver computes certified backward reachable tubes fast enough to execute inside active robot control loops for deterministic safety guarantees.
technical.why: It provides a crucial deterministic safety layer to complement probabilistic policies in autonomous systems.

technical.title: VidUEU-Agent Automates Multimodal Instruction Data Generation from Raw Videos
technical.summary: VidUEU-Agent is an automated four-stage pipeline that filters raw videos, mines keyframes, and synthesizes high-quality instruction data to alleviate the data scarcity bottleneck in multimodal learning.
technical.why: It helps scale up multimodal model training by efficiently turning raw video into annotated instruction data.

technical.title: CoReMatch Enables Real-Time Robotic Feature Matching via Continuous Coordinate Refinement
technical.summary: CoReMatch is a recurrent framework that progressively improves feature correspondence estimates in continuous coordinate space rather than relying on discrete confidence maps on fixed grids.
technical.why: It offers a more efficient approach for real-time visual localization, mapping, and SLAM in robotics.

technical.title: Tencent WeVisOne-VL Unifies Multiple Vision Tasks in an Open-Source Model
technical.summary: WeVisOne-VL is an Apache 2.0 vision-language model available in 2B and 4B parameters that simultaneously handles detection, OCR, counting, segmentation, and alpha matting.
technical.why: It provides edge-friendly, multi-task computer vision capabilities in a single compact architecture.

technical.title: DiMuRe Framework Uses Diagnosis-Guided Multilevel Recovery for Robotic Task Execution
technical.summary: DiMuRe is a robotic agent framework that uses phase-specific evidence and multimodal large language models to choose between program reuse, predefined recovery skills, and corrective code generation when disturbances occur.
technical.why: It improves the resilience of autonomous robotic systems when unexpected disturbances invalidate current actions.

technical.title: FactEmbed Factorizes MLLM Embeddings to Improve Composed Image Retrieval
technical.summary: Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed) decouples compositional query comprehension from embedding generation to better utilize multimodal large language models for composed image retrieval.
technical.why: It enhances visual modification understanding for more accurate image retrieval using reference images and text.

technical.title: ScienceVision Benchmark Evaluates AI Understanding and Reasoning on 3D Scientific Data
technical.summary: ScienceVision is a cross-domain 3D benchmark utilizing expert-level visual question answering to evaluate AI models on spatial structures, protein contacts, and anatomical organization.
technical.why: It establishes standardized evaluation protocols for 3D computer vision tasks in scientific domains.

business.title: AMD Stock Jumps 8% on Strong Third-Quarter Earnings
business.summary: AMD reported better-than-expected third-quarter results, driven by booming sales of AI chips, causing its stock to jump 8% as data center revenue nearly doubled.
business.why: It shows strong market demand and commercial viability for hardware powering AI infrastructure.

business.title: Global Venture Funding Reaches $59 Billion in October
business.summary: Global venture funding in October totaled $59 billion, a 45% jump from a year earlier, largely due to a record-setting $15.9 billion funding round for China's DeepSeek.
business.why: Massive capital inflows continue to shape the scale and competitive landscape of AI startups.

business.title: AI Inference Startup Fal Doubles Valuation to $16B
business.summary: The five-year-old AI inference startup Fal doubled its valuation to $16 billion after raising a $1.3 billion round led by Bessemer as demand surges.
business.why: High valuations for inference providers highlight growing operational scaling needs in the industry.

business.title: Ballistic Ventures Seeks $490M for New Cybersecurity Funds
business.summary: Cybersecurity-focused Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $360 million for a new flagship fund and another $130 million for a separate investment vehicle amid an AI-driven cybersecurity boom.
business.why: Venture capital continues to target security applications surrounding emerging AI deployments.

business.title: Palantir sinks after earnings as analysts point to slowdown in total contract value
business.summary: The software giant's stock fell after earnings failed to impress investors.

business.title: Shopify falls over 8% after Q3 revenue and merchandise volume miss estimates
business.summary: Shopify's stock fell after the e-commerce platform's Q3 revenue and gross merchandise volume missed estimates, despite an adjusted earnings beat.

business.title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps
business.summary: Apple hinted at ways that it could spur revenue through third-party "opportunities" during its Monday night earnings call.

business.title: More Money, Fewer Checks: These 3 Charts Show The Divide Behind VC’s Record Funding Year
business.summary: Record venture funding in 2026 has been increasingly concentrated in massive AI rounds, while seed- and early-stage deal counts are on the decline. Using Crunchbase data we provide a look at how third-quarter funding con

business.title: Ukraine’s drone strikes spur hasty Russian plans for underground data centers
business.summary: Russia tries to fix exposed digital infrastructure as data center war backfires.

business.title: ‘Our Risk, Their Reward’: Zohran Mamdani on AI and Data Centers
business.summary: Ahead of the midterms, WIRED talked to New York City’s mayor about data centers, AI in schools, and the future of the Democratic party.

models.title: Mistral Large 4 Unveils Trillion-Parameter Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Model
models.summary: Mistral Large 4 is a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token. It unifies instruction following, reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows, and surpasses closed models on visual grounding.
models.why: Offers state-of-the-art multimodal reasoning and visual grounding for complex AI engineering pipelines.

models.title: Idol Generates 3D Gaussian Splats From a Single Image
models.summary: Idol turns a single image, render, or photo into up to a million 3D Gaussian Gaussians written as a standard 3DGS .ply file. It infers unseen sides, runs on consumer GPUs using 7.2 GB of VRAM, and completes generation in under 2 seconds.
models.why: Directly impacts computer vision workflows by enabling rapid single-image 3D asset reconstruction.

models.title: CCOre Releases Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder for Interactive 3D Scene Generation
models.summary: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder is an independent fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B exploring small language models for general coding and high-quality 3D scene generation, specifically targeting interactive scenes with Three.js.
models.why: Demonstrates specialized small-scale language model capabilities for 3D graphics and scene generation.

models.title: Quantized Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo Released With Uncensored Generation Support
models.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1 Turbo Quantized offers the base 7B visual generation architecture which natively supports uncensored image generation without a built-in safety checker. It achieves generation in 10 to 20 seconds using 8 denoising steps across various quantized formats.
models.why: Offers flexible, unconstrained visual generation options for specialized image synthesis pipelines.

models.title: NVIDIA Releases Open-Weight Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Speech Model
models.summary: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B is an open-weight speech and audio model supporting transcription in 40 languages. It features a 65,536-token context, handles recordings up to one hour, and uses a hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture activating 4.3B parameters.
models.why: Provides efficient multi-language offline audio transcription capabilities for edge and server deployments.

models.title: LiquidAI Launches LFM3-1.7B Text Model for Local Edge Agents
models.summary: LFM3-1.7B is a text model built on a new tri-hybrid architecture designed for local agents and edge deployment. It features a 256K-token context window, fits on phones or laptops using about 1 GB of memory at 4-bit precision, and supports single-GPU fine-tuning.
models.why: Enables efficient deployment of specialized agentic workloads directly onto consumer hardware.
